coordinator_message: Current review findings: legacy_wire_decoder.rs uses bytes.len() as u64 and unchecked JSON indexing manifest["cases"], c["name"], case["length"], case["blake3"]. Replace with checked conversion and .get(...).and_then(...) without allow exceptions. Keep new cross-crate tests in workspace_tests, portable tracked fixture bytes and provenance. Current public parse_event typed outcome must be measured and asserted, not guessed. Stale completion and queued stale failure must each assert complete serialized journal equality plus current pending ticket/counters unchanged; current valid ticket must complete to actual RunFinished. Finish scoped gates, report true outcomes, freeze promptly. Do not self-approve independent review.
